def process(roman_cities):
    import pandas as pd
    df = roman_cities.copy()
    df = df.rename(columns={'Longitude (X)':'lng','Latitude (Y)':'lat'})
    df['lat'] = pd.to_numeric(df['lat'], errors='coerce')
    df['lng'] = pd.to_numeric(df['lng'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['lat','lng'])
    return df[['Primary Key','Ancient Toponym','Modern Toponym','Country','lat','lng']]

def process(worldcities_100k, roman_coords):
    import numpy as np
    wc = worldcities_100k.copy()
    rc = roman_coords.copy()

    # Cross join via numpy broadcasting to test proximity in degrees
    wc_lat = wc['lat'].to_numpy()[:, None]
    wc_lng = wc['lng'].to_numpy()[:, None]
    rc_lat = rc['lat'].to_numpy()[None, :]
    rc_lng = rc['lng'].to_numpy()[None, :]

    close = (np.abs(wc_lat - rc_lat) <= 0.1) & (np.abs(wc_lng - rc_lng) <= 0.1)
    any_close = close.any(axis=1)

    out = wc.loc[any_close, ['id', 'city', 'country', 'lat', 'lng', 'population']].copy()
    out['matched_roman_city_count'] = close[any_close].sum(axis=1)
    return out
